selected_object.label: Professor Fluffington (Plush Bear)
selected_object.description: Well-loved brown teddy bear with button eyes and an honorary doctorate in chaotic arcade physics.

announcer_lines.intro: PROFESSOR FLUFFINGTON ARRIVES! Armed with button eyes, polyester fluff, and zero fear.

round1.intro: CUDDLY DEMOLITION: Swing the distinguished professor through the front door of the spooky manor!
round1.win: MAXIMUM FLUFF IMPACT: The ghosts were hugged into peaceful submission and relocated!
round1.lose: MILD TUMBLE: The teddy bear bounced gently off the porch. Time for afternoon tea!

round2.intro: ALIEN CUDDLE PROTOCOL: Extraterrestrial scientists spotted high plush levels! Abduct the bear!
round2.win: INTERSTELLAR EMBRACE: Alien empire pacified by overwhelming softness!
round2.lose: BUTTON LOSS AVOIDED: The tractor beam malfunctioned; teddy stayed grounded!

round3.intro: VOLCANIC FLUFF SURFING: Keep the polyester stuffing safe from falling pumice rocks!
round3.win: UNSCORCHED PROFESSOR: Teddy navigated the fiery caldera with pristine fur!
round3.lose: STUFFING LEAK: A molten pebble singed the bow tie! Evacuate immediately!

announcer_lines.summary: DIPLOMATIC TRIUMPH: Professor Fluffington pacified ghosts, charmed alien invaders and survived volcanic fury.
